ceiling.source: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/h100/ — NVIDIA publishes sparse tensor figures; dense shown at half. FP32 is the non-tensor rate.

network.source: https://docs.nvidia.com/dgx/dgxh100-user-guide/introduction-to-dgxh100.html (checked 2026-11-05) — eight H100s and eight single-port ConnectX-7 cards, InfiniBand up to 400 Gbps each. NVIDIA publishes no end-to-end latency; 5 μs is the GPU ↔ GPU RDMA row of https://github.com/sirupsen/napkin-math (checked 2026-11-05), which also rounds the rate to 40 GiB/s.
